table.retrieve:
SELECT itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:' + LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END,   
         aliasname=item.customicode,    
          packingdesc=item.packingdesc,    
         accname = dbo.accounts.name,
			saleledgermodified.editablesaleinvcode,
			reprintcount= saleledgermodified.reprintingcounter,
			custalias=dbo.accounts.aliasname,   
         address = dbo.customer.address1,
         address2= dbo.customer.address2,
			custcity=dbo.customer.city,
			custlisc= dbo.customer.licenceno,  
			manufacturer=manufacturer.name,
         salesman = dbo.users.username,   
         saleinvcode = dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode,   
         headerno = dbo.saleledgermodified.headerno,   
         date = dbo.saleledgermodified.date,   
         invdiscperc = dbo.saleledgermodified.discperc,   
         misccharges = dbo.saleledgermodified.misccharges,   
         flatdisc = dbo.saleledgermodified.flatdisc,   
         invsalestax = dbo.saleledgermodified.salestax,   
         gcode = saledetailmodified.gcode,   
         icode = saledetailmodified.icode,   
         batch = saledetailmodified.batch,   
         expiry = saledetailmodified.expiry,   
         looseqty = saledetailmodified.looseqty,   
         bonusqty = saledetailmodified.bonusqty,   
         packqty = saledetailmodified.packqty,   
         packunits= saledetailmodified.packunits,   
         saleprice= saledetailmodified.saleprice,   
         discperc = saledetailmodified.discperc,  
			itemflatdisc=saledetailmodified.itemflatdisc,   
         salestax = saledetailmodified.salestax,   
         Id = dbo.saledetailmodified.IDENTITYCOL,   
         posted=saleledgermodified.posted,   
         balance=0,   
         unitsalestax = saledetailmodified.unitsalestax,   
         gstperc = saledetailmodified.gstperc,   
         invgstperc = saleledgermodified.invgstperc1,   
         custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
			dbo.saleledgermodified.custrefno,	
			dbo.saleledgermodified.remarks,
			dbo.saleledgermodified.printwaranty,
			dbo.saleledgermodified.printbatch,
			custcode = saleledgermodified.custcode,
			salecatcode = saleledgermodified.salecatcode,
			serverdate = getdate(),
			deliverdby = (select name from salesman where salesmancode = saleledgermodified.deliveredby), 
			saleperson = (select name from salesman where salesmancode = saleledgermodified.smancode),
			messages = (select description from message where messagecode = saleledgermodified.messagecode)
    FROM saleledgermodified,   
         saledetailmodified,   
         accounts,   
         customer,
			manufacturer,   
         users,   
         item  
   WHERE ( dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode = :ar_SaleInvCode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledgermodified.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetailmodified.saleinvcode) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledgermodified.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saleledgermodified.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
         ( dbo.saledetailmodified.icode = dbo.item.icode)and
			( dbo.item.manfcode=manufacturer.manfcode)    
ORDER BY dbo.saledetailmodified.saleinvcode,
			manufacturer.name,
			item.name,
			dbo.saledetailmodified.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: c_totaltax
objects.expression: Round(Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) ,2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2) + sum(c_salestaxval for all) , 0)

objects.name: t_39
objects.visible: 1	if(Round(Sum (  c_amount for all ) * ( invdiscperc * .01) , 2)  + sum( Round(looseqty *(saleprice*  discperc *0.01),2) for all)>0,1,0)

objects.name: compute_18
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_amount for all ) * ( invdiscperc * .01) , 2)  + sum( Round(looseqty *(saleprice*  discperc *0.01),2) for all)

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) )

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: /*Round ( Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)*/Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: (  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty )

objects.name: compute_15
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for group 1)

objects.name: compute_14
objects.expression: sum((  looseqty   * ( saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) for group 1)
